numerical_admission: All 14 cases and 70 independent timed workers verified; all 700 full engine/component calls and 100 separate core diagnostic calls passed the declared numerical checks. Original records are unchanged.
thread_control_deviation: The original protocol claimed native_threads=1 but did not set POLARS_MAX_THREADS or observe the Polars pool. A post-campaign fresh process using the same eight declared variables and same Limen environment reproduced a Polars pool size of 9. Polars actual pool size was not recorded during the original campaign. The follow-up observation supports a control gap, not a retrospective measurement of its active threads.
use: Preserve as an exploratory observed run and failure/correction history. Do not present as the canonical controlled single-thread benchmark or use its ratios as the final controlled ranking.
replacement: A separately preregistered corrective campaign adds the explicit Polars environment control and loaded-pool admission before and after every call.
bt_profile: One post-campaign cProfile attribution run, outside comparative timing. Native get_transactions independently invokes two DataFrame.unstack operations; their cumulative cost dominates extraction in this environment. Profiler durations are not comparable timing samples.
